item.infinitycraft.arrow_deflection_ring:
Arrows, tridents and the like just bounce off you.
Each hit you block costs 1 durability; when it runs out, the ring is done for.
Stay in decent light (above 7) and you instantly heal (Instant Health II).
Works in any accessory slot.
item.infinitycraft.baguette_talisman.des:
You're always hungry (permanent Hunger I).
But every hit you take stacks Resistance, I → II → III, each lasting 25 seconds.
Once you reach III, you have to wait for it to wear off before it starts over from I.
item.infinitycraft.iron_steel_armor.desc:
Grants 5 Armor and 6 Armor Toughness.
Extends your invulnerability window after a hit by 0.1s.
item.infinitycraft.gold_steel_armor.desc:
Piglins won't attack you on sight.
Extends post-hit invulnerability by 0.2s.
item.infinitycraft.diamond_steel_armor.d:
Phantoms won't spawn near you, and Piglins won't attack on sight.
Extends post-hit invulnerability by 0.3s.
item.infinitycraft.netherite_steel_armor:
Permanent fire resistance, no Phantoms spawning nearby, and Piglins stay neutral.
Extends post-hit invulnerability by 0.4s.
item.infinitycraft.nether_star_steel_arm:
Immune to magic damage, plus permanent fire resistance, no Phantoms and neutral Piglins.
Extends post-hit invulnerability by 0.5s.
item.infinitycraft.nailong_mask.desc:
Stare at any creature within 32 blocks and it freezes in place.
Look away and it's free to move again.
item.infinitycraft.bing_bing_bing.desc:
When you take more than 2 damage, every mob within 16 blocks freezes for 6 seconds (AI disabled).
25 second cooldown.
item.infinitycraft.stone_mask.desc:
You deal 20% more damage, lifesteal from mobs (healing for half the damage you deal), and eat faster.
The catch: sunlight burns you during the day.
item.infinitycraft.nut_wall.desc:
Drags every hostile mob within 20 blocks onto you, and the aggro won't drift to anyone else.
When hit, you gain Resistance IV and Slowness IV for 20 seconds.
Also works when held in your off-hand.
item.infinitycraft.meteor_streak.desc:
Don't loose the bow the instant it's fully drawn—every extra second you hold adds 100% damage to that arrow.
Caps out at 50x the original damage.
item.infinitycraft.jie_toilet_cleaner.de:
Tanks the next 3 hits you take (each has to land at least 1 second apart to count).
After all 3 are used, you instantly lose 70% of your max health—yes, it can kill you.
Then it goes on a 60 second cooldown before you get all 3 back.
item.infinitycraft.crude_spicy_candy.des: Keeps you warm: immune to freezing damage, and you won't get hypothermia from powder snow.
item.infinitycraft.fire_and_steel.desc:
Immune to fire damage, and any flames on you burn out instantly.
Melee attacks set the target alight for 4 seconds.
Hitting a target that's already burning ignores armor and deals 5x damage.
Every melee hit also adds fixed damage equal to 5% of the target's max health.
item.infinitycraft.defy_death.desc:
Right-click while held to record your current coordinates.
On death, a "Death Return" option appears; clicking it revives you at the recorded point (works in Hardcore too, reviving in Survival).
One-time use: the accessory is consumed after Death Return; your other curios are not dropped on death.
item.infinitycraft.sun_ring.desc: While equipped, continuously knocks back hostile mobs within 2 blocks, forming a repelling field that keeps enemies at bay.
item.infinitycraft.bei_zhi_su.desc:
Immune to fall damage.
Jump about 2 blocks high and step up 1-block-tall blocks directly.
While equipped, press C to open your Ender Chest.
item.infinitycraft.mysterious_coin.desc:
Right-click while held to fire a blue beam (100-block range).
On impact it detonates a block-safe explosion (5-block radius) dealing 10-100000 random damage to creatures in range.
30-minute cooldown.
item.infinitycraft.world_slash.desc:
Right-click while held to lock onto the pointed spot (up to 16 blocks).
Over 5 seconds it unleashes 15 slashes; each deals 100 damage (ignoring armor, resistance and invulnerability frames) and immobilizes creatures within 3 blocks.
When it ends, all survivors in range are erased and the caster pays with their life to the curse.
item.infinitycraft.tempered_blade.desc:
While in your inventory, using an anvil costs no experience and never becomes "too expensive".
Each item you take out counts +1; after 30 uses it transforms in place into "Eternal in Flames".
item.infinitycraft.eternal_in_flames.des:
50 attack damage, 1.7 attack speed, 2700 durability.
Melee attacks with this sword in the main hand ignore all damage reduction (armor, protection enchantments and resistance are nullified).
Cannot be repaired.
item.infinitycraft.qiaolezi.desc:
6 hunger / 8 saturation.
Grants Qiaolezi Storm III for 30 seconds when eaten.
item.infinitycraft.xuebi.desc:
2 hunger / 2 saturation.
Grants Sprite Storm III for 60 seconds when drunk.
item.infinitycraft.gugu_xuebi.desc:
A soda bottle bloated with fizz - it is a firework all by itself.
Right-click to launch (at the sky or at a block); about 1.5 seconds after lift-off it bursts into a cloud of soda bubbles.
While elytra-flying, right-click to burn it as a rocket boost.
jei.infinitycraft.flawless_star.desc: Use in Smithing Table with the Flawless Star Upgrade Smithing Template and any durable item (including netherite) to make it Unbreakable.
Obtained by brushing suspicious sand/gravel (archaeology), or by mining pickaxe-mineable blocks with a pickaxe enchanted with Archaeological Prospecting. Hold and right-click with a pickaxe (costs 3 durability plus the ball) to crack it open for random rewards: minerals, experience, archaeology products, smithing templates, enchanted golden apples, the Lost Ancient Book, and even items from other mods.
jei.infinitycraft.lost_ancient_book.desc: An ancient book bearing over-leveled enchantments. Like an enchanted book, it can transfer its enchantments to other items on an anvil. Found in loot chests, or obtained via archaeology brushing and Mysterious Stone Balls.
jei.infinitycraft.xuebi.desc:
Crafting path: any potion + 2 sugar + 1 magma cream, shapeless in a crafting table (the water bottle on the recipe page stands for any potion).
Sprite inherits the effects of the potion used and applies them together with Sprite Storm when drunk.
Crafting Sprite with gunpowder into Plump Sprite strips every inherited potion effect.
jei.infinitycraft.gugu_xuebi.desc:
Crafted from Sprite + gunpowder, shapeless in a crafting table; strips every potion effect the Sprite inherited.
Launches just like a firework rocket, see the item tooltip for details.
